prompts.A:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished game VFX concept sheet, NOT a real gameplay capture.
Input image is a REAL 1280x720 Karen Slay the Spire 2 mod screenshot: use its exact painted-anime battle environment, native lower-left red faceted energy counter, cream energy digits, adjacent draw pile and existing UI. The ability being redesigned is "舞台正在等待着": when the actual promise pile becomes empty it grants real energy. The persistent occupied/empty states must now be designed at the ENERGY COUNTER, not Karen's chest. The previous thin gold/blue edge-outline concept was rejected. The new design must have a recognizable theatrical silhouette and composition, NOT another recolored border.
One landscape sheet: three upper panels of equal size at identical zoom, showing the energy counter plus surrounding local game environment. Bottom: one wide real-scale battlefield context panel derived from the screenshot, where the energy counter remains at its native original size and location. Show how modest the effect is in the actual layout. All captions OUTSIDE the game image on simple dark strips, no ornamental poster frame. Three phase labels in this exact order: "有牌 · 候场", "清空 · 回能", "空堆 · 待续". Footer "设计预览 · 非实机". No explanatory paragraphs inside the image.
Preserve the cream foreground digits, with 8/3 in occupied, then 9/3 in actual-gain transition and empty state. This numerical change represents an actual +1 gain, never a persistent fake resource. Preserve the counter's native size; don't turn it into an oversized new HUD panel or move it higher in the battlefield. Keep draw/discard icons and hand unobscured. The tower and character do not receive any new mark, slit, chest ring, glowing belly, particle stream, fan, door or backdrop. Remove the old chest slit from the reference. No giant five-point star, ground base, podium, ticket, ribbon, long beam crossing the battlefield, circular magic ring, progress bar, added energy reserve, duplicate power icon or digit obstruction.
The sheet is an illustrative design mockup; all bottom panel styling must remain as close to the real gameplay as possible.
Concept A: "能量槽内的小剧场". Make a genuinely theatrical miniature within the existing red counter footprint, using two cel-painted crimson velvet curtain pieces and a dark backstage interior. This is an ability overlay, not a permanent character redesign.
Occupied: CLOSED red velvet curtain fills the counter face BEHIND the readable 8/3 digits. Two broad unmistakable folded fabric masses meet softly; visible fabric pleats, NOT a bright thin slit or just edge trim. The counter's small native faceted outer red silhouette remains. No new frame, rigid architecture, gold swag, wood, base or stage floor.
Actual empty + gain: the two fabric halves visibly PULL APART sideways and tuck towards the upper outer corners. A single short cool-white theatre light bloom lights the newly exposed dark interior behind 9/3; a handful of tiny warm sparks flick outward along the opening motion. Clear opening motion, no luminous door panels or two beam lips.
Already empty: curtains stay OPEN, reduced to two folded red accents inside the upper corners. A dark wine-blue empty stage recess occupies the existing counter face; extremely quiet narrow pearly light washes the back interior behind the clean cream 9/3. No floor disk, empty seats, tiny actor, miniature tower, permanent flare or repeated energy burst. The strong red CLOSED vs dark OPEN silhouette is the primary state signal. Closing after refill would restore the cloth quietly.
Bottom context: show the OPEN idle state at native small scale, so the viewer can judge legibility next to the actual draw pile. Top title "A｜能量槽内的小剧场".

Concept B: "让能量槽成为追光落点". Keep the native red counter face fully unchanged; create a short local theatre-followspot composition in the negative space DIRECTLY ABOVE and behind it. No curtain or hardware, no arch or stage rig, no frame or outline recoloring. Use painterly volumetric light and sparse dust.
Occupied: two SHORT narrow warm-red slanted wedges of theatre light remain separated, aimed down towards the left and right BACK edges of the counter; an obvious small unlit V-shaped gap stays above the 8/3. Their broad ends end behind the counter, never in front of digits. This is calm low light, with a few dust motes. Distinct two-wing silhouette, constrained to about 55 native pixels above the counter and 15 pixels to its sides.
Actual empty + real gain: both short wedges SWIVEL INWARD, cross in the open space just above the counter and converge into one brief white-gold focused highlight at its upper rim. A few short fine streaks sink behind the red counter, showing energy arrival. The 9/3 is clean. Bright only in this transition.
Already empty: the converged light rests as ONE extremely soft narrow cool-white down-light directly behind the counter, with faint dust above it; no two warm wings, no pulsing, no outline glow or active energy increase. Empty silhouette is a single calm column vs occupied split wedges. Keep it local: the top of the soft column is at most 55 native pixels above the counter and fades out without a visible lamp.
Bottom context: show OCCUPIED split-wedge idle at actual native small scale, clear of Karen/tower and draw pile. Top title "B｜能量槽成为追光落点".
